accelerator.name: SOSV HAX / SOSV NY / SOSV SF

summary: SOSV accepts applications to its distinct HAX, SOSV NY and SOSV SF programs on a rolling basis. The calendar opportunity here is specifically HAX: hard-tech development with a six-month Newark residency. The former IndieBio name changed to SOSV NY and SOSV SF in 2026.

proposed_event.name: HAX — Rolling Hard-Tech Applications
proposed_event.description: Hands-on hard-tech startup development with engineering support, labs and a six-month Newark residency. Investment terms require confirmation; at least two team members are required before program entry.

dates.date_range_text: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Six-month residency; no fixed application cutoff or cohort start date is published.

sources.title: IndieBio — The Original
sources.supports: Official announcement explains the 2026 rename to SOSV NY and SOSV SF.

sources.title: SOSV Application FAQ
sources.supports: Rolling application review; applicants need at least two team members to enter a program.

sources.title: The HAX Program
sources.supports: Hard-tech support and up to $550K initial funding with a six-month Newark residency.

sources.title: Apply to SOSV programs
sources.supports: Separate application choices for HAX, SOSV NY and SOSV SF; supports keeping the programs distinct.

notes: The calendar record covers HAX only. SOSV NY and SOSV SF have separate locations, technical focuses and investment teams.
SOSV requires at least two team members to join a program; a solo applicant must find a cofounder before funding and entry.

The HAX program page advertises up to $550K initial funding, while older FAQ figures differ. Confirm the actual investment instrument, amount and equity directly; no standardized deal is asserted here.
Rolling application review is explicit in the official SOSV FAQ; there is no fixed cohort deadline or assumed start day.
